title: Irish Stew with a Keto Twist
description: A low-carb, high-fat version of the classic Irish stew. The potatoes have been replaced with a delicious and innovative ingredient.

ingredients.name: keto-friendly seasoning
ingredients.notes: such as salt, pepper, and dried thyme

instructions: 1. In a large Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until browned.
2. Remove the bacon from the pot and set aside.
3. Add the beef and sirloin to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the innovative ingredient and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
5. Add the broth, bacon, and seasonings to the pot.
6. Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
7. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
